name: Imayoshi Chiri
source:
Manato's ex-girlfriend.

She lived with Manato, but they argued often and broke up a while before Manato invited Haruno to live with him.

She meets Haruno for some reason, but...?

[Translated from [url=http://dswtc.web.fc2.com/game/nekonare/nekonare.html]official website[/url]]
